body.statement: There is an exact deterministic algorithm which, for a square-free integer polynomial of degree \(d\) and coefficient bit length \(\tau\), returns pairwise disjoint rational isolating intervals containing all and only its real roots in bit time polynomial in \(d+\tau+1\); the interval endpoint bit lengths are polynomial in the same quantity.

source.verbatim_statement: For the special case where \(F\) has integer coefficients of maximal bitsize \(\tau\), our bound on the bit complexity writes as \(\widetilde O(n^3\tau^2)\).

attestation.note: Transcribed from the arXiv abstract, arXiv:1011.0344.
